title: CLDT marked-trail junctions dataset
description: OSM route relations (route=hiking/foot) that branch off the CLDT, snapped to the trail polyline at their nearest-approach km. One entry per relation. Sourced from OpenStreetMap, not an authoritative HPS Registar lookup - name/ref/osmc:symbol/network are OSM tags and may be incomplete. Consumed by the marked-trail junction data-book layer, the distance overlay, and the stage planner. Generated by scripts/enrich-trail-junctions.ts.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the enrichment script last ran.

totalKm.description: Total CLDT length in kilometres at the time of enrichment; sanity check against the live GPX.

junctions.description: Sorted by trailKm ascending. One entry per OSM route relation that comes within the snap radius of the CLDT.

trailKm.description: SOBO km of the CLDT point where the marked trail comes nearest (branches off).

name.description: OSM name of the branching route relation (name / name:hr / name:en). May be absent.

ref.description: OSM ref of the branching route relation (often an HPS number; unreliable in OSM). May be absent.

network.description: OSM network tag (e.g. iwn, nwn, rwn, lwn). May be absent.

osmcSymbol.description: OSM osmc:symbol tag: free-form waymark description whose leading token is a colour. May be absent.

markColor.description: Optional precomputed CSS colour for the chip; when absent the runtime derives it from osmcSymbol.

offBearingDeg.description: Great-circle bearing (deg clockwise from north) the marked trail heads as it leaves the CLDT. May be absent.

proximity.description: How the marked trail meets the CLDT: 'crosses' when it shares the junction point, 'near' when it only passes within the snap radius.
